content                        single diagram or composed scene
DiagramSourceContext       per diagram within the saved content
MappingWorkspaceStore                         owns the saved editing session

content.ascii:
PersistentLayer
|
|-- DiagramStore                                  main repository facade
|   |
|   |-- Project
|   |   |-- id / name
|   |   `-- diagramSetIds[] -----------------------> DiagramSet records
|   |
|   |-- DiagramSet                                collection and generation context
|   |   |-- id / projectId / name
|   |   |
|   |   |-- codeEntities: CodeEntitiesSet
|   |   |   `-- entities[]: CodeEntity
|   |   |       |-- id / label / category
|   |   |       `-- sourceRanges[]
|   |   |           |-- source path
|   |   |           |-- startLine / endLine
|   |   |           `-- originalLines              captured source evidence
|   |   |
|   |   |-- diagrams[]: Diagram                    generated artifacts
|   |   |   |-- id / name
|   |   |   |-- ASCII content
|   |   |   `-- mappings[]
|   |   |       |-- diagram text span
|   |   |       `-- entity + source range ---------> codeEntities
|   |   |
|   |   `-- components[]: DiagramComponent         reusable diagram fragments
|   |       `-- Content and source mappings
|   |
|   `-- projectCatalogs: ProjectCatalogStore       owns saved identities and revisions
|       |
|       |-- RepresentationCatalog
|       |   |-- projectId
|       |   |-- activeByKind                       selected representation per view
|       |   |
|       |   |-- representations[id]: Representation
|       |   |   |-- id / name / kind / status
|       |   |   |-- currentRevisionId ------------> revisions[id]
|       |   |   `-- revisionIds[]                  retained history
|       |   |
|       |   |-- revisions[id]: RepresentationRevision
|       |   |   |-- id / revision
|       |   |   |-- representationId -------------> representations[id]
|       |   |   |-- provenance?                    originating artifact
|       |   |   |
|       |   |   `-- content                        single diagram or composed scene
|       |   |       |
|       |   |       |-- DiagramContent
|       |   |       |   |-- ASCII / content hash
|       |   |       |   `-- structure
|       |   |       |       |-- unstructured diagram
|       |   |       |       `-- parsed tree
|       |   |       |           `-- nodes[id]
|       |   |       |               |-- label / original line
|       |   |       |               `-- parent / children
|       |   |       |
|       |   |       `-- DiagramSourceContext       per diagram within the saved content
|       |   |           |-- binding?               identifies the source repository
|       |   |           |-- evidence[id]           captured source entities and ranges
|       |   |           `-- mappings[]
|       |   |               |-- diagram text span
|       |   |               `-- entity + range ----> evidence[id].sourceRanges
|       |   |
|       |   `-- projections[id]                    relationships between representations
|       |       |-- source representation / revision
|       |       |-- target representation / revision
|       |       `-- links                          source evidence -> target tree nodes
|       |
|       |-- CompactionCatalog
|       |   |-- activeByPath[path] ----------------> compactions[id]
|       |   `-- compactions[id]: FileCompaction
|       |       |-- source path / source hash
|       |       |-- startLine / endLine
|       |       |-- originalLines
|       |       `-- compactedSource                retained source presentation
|       |
|       `-- Operations
|           |-- promoteRepresentation(...)
|           |   `-- Generated artifact -> saved identity + captured revision.
|           |
|           |-- saveMappingDiagram(...)
|           |   `-- Editable document content -> new representation revision.
|           |
|           |-- saveProjectedTree(...)
|           |   `-- Derived tree -> saved representation + projection relationship.
|           |
|           `-- archiveRepresentation(...)
|               `-- Retire the saved identity while retaining its history.
|
|-- MappingWorkspaceStore                         owns the saved editing session
|   |
|   `-- MappingWorkspaceSnapshot
|       |-- projectId
|       |-- activeDocumentId ---------------------> documents[id]
|       |
|       `-- documents[]: MappingDocumentSnapshot
|           |-- document identity / name
|           |-- savedRepresentationId? -----------> RepresentationCatalog.representations
|           |-- revisionId -----------------------> baseline saved revision
|           |
|           |-- document                          current editable content
|           |   `-- Scene + diagrams + their source contexts
|           |       `-- May contain changes absent from the saved revision.
|           |
|           |-- canvas                            retained panes and controls
|           `-- viewport                          camera position
|               |
|               |-- Open representation -> create an editable document.
|               |-- Save diagram --------> ProjectCatalogStore saves a revision.
|               `-- Save workspace ------> capture the complete editing session.
|
`-- SearchArtifact persistence                    PROPOSED derived output
    |
    |-- DiagramSearchArtifact
    |   |-- derived from -------------------------> parsed diagram content
    |   |-- searchable text                       node labels with original line labels
    |   `-- row metadata -------------------------> node ID + original text location
    |
    |-- Mapped source-file membership
    |   |-- derived from -------------------------> diagram source mappings
    |   |-- source identity + path                one entry per referenced file
    |   |-- search scope                          complete file contents
    |   `-- owners -------------------------------> referencing diagram nodes
    |
    `-- Persistence hooks
        |-- Diagram created / revised -> write its SearchArtifact.
        |-- Mappings saved -----------> update mapped source-file membership.
        `-- Diagram archived / removed -> remove obsolete search membership.
